rationale: Dispatching two drones to the highest-risk URM-infill and steel blocks south of the helicopter's current path, where the model predicts up to 65% probability of complete destruction across buildings housing over 15,000 people. D1 will survey the One Sansome Street block, while D2 assesses the 32 Battery Street block—which AIR 1 could not see—and nearby unscanned blocks at 50 Fremont Center and the PG&E Building. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up on new collapses or trapped survivors.
